recentItems.title: The Uplift: Dolly Parton
recentItems.description:
Dolly Parton was known for her music, acting, glitz and glam – but there is more to the star that meets the eye. We celebrate Dolly's legacy and philanthropy and her alter-ego, "The Book Lady."

"The Uplift" is a weekly show anchored by Shanelle Kaul that spotlights news stories that inspire, motivate and tug at your heartstrings.

recentItems.title: His dad died saving co-workers on 9/11. Now he's helping others grieve and grow.
recentItems.description:
